section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the relationship between connectedness to nature, nature exposure, and body appreciation in 399 U.S. adults (Mage = 34.55 years) using an online survey. Path analysis revealed that nature exposure and connectedness to nature were associated with body appreciation both directly and indirectly through self-esteem, with gender differences in mediation pathways.
